FINAL REMAINING UNIT HOUSE NO.2 - SHOWHOUSE

Sherry FitzGerald are delighted to advise that there is now just one remaining home available in the Barnakyle Gardens development House No. 2 - The Showhouse. 

This property is finished to an exceptional standard and represents a final opportunity to secure a stunning A-rated family home in the popular village of Patrickswell, Co. Limerick.

A development of the highest calibre and designed for modern living using the most sustainable, technologically advanced, and energy-efficient materials available. 
Barnakyle Gardens combine elegant, well-designed homes with the perfect location. This development is set in one of Limerick's most historic towns. With an enviable location along the M20, Patrickswell is the ideal commuter destination, giving direct access to Limerick city centre and Raheen Business Park while still enjoying all the wonderful benefits of contemporary country living.
